title: PolicyRequest
description: What the enforcement layer sends to the configured safeguard-policy contract for one account of an operation. Deliberately minimal: the token (so one policy can apply per-token rules), the screened account, and the operation context needed to interpret the account's role. It NEVER carries amounts, balances, commitments, or any private financial data — that is the privacy boundary of the enforcement layer.

token.description: The token being operated on; part of every policy call so a single policy can serve many tokens.

account.description: The account screened by this request (the party whose role the operation names).

counterparty.description: The other party of a bilateral operation (from for a 'to' request and vice versa); omitted for register/merge.

spender.description: The delegated-flow spender; only present when the screened party participates in a transfer_from.

context.description: Deployment-defined opaque context the policy may interpret; never private financial data.

address.description: Stellar address: G… for accounts, C… for contracts.
